sentences.text: 08.11.2023 CRM (M) 950/2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners at length and perused the record available on file.
Issue notice to the respondents, returnable within two weeks, subject to filing of requisites within one week.

Meanwhile, subject to objections from the other side and till next date of hearing before the Bench,
it is ordered that Respondent No. 1 shall go ahead with the investigation in case arising out of FIR No. 14/2023 dated 13.06.2023 registered with Women Police Station, Doda against the petitioners for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 498A/323/504 IPC, however, charge sheet shall not be filed before the competent court of law without the prior permission of this Court.

Through the medium of this application, learned counsel for the applicants seek permission of this Court to exempt the applicants to file certified copy of the FIR No. 14/2023 dated 13.06.2023 registered with Women Police Station, Doda for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 498A/323/504 IPC.
